newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moderate earthquake shakes Tokyo, suburbs.
newsitem.headline: Moderate earthquake shakes Tokyo, suburbs.

text.p: A moderate earthquake shook Tokyo and its northeastern suburbs, including Narita international airport, on Wednesday, the Japan Meteorological Agency said.

An agency official said the tremor registered 2.0 on the open-ended Richter scale and 4.5 on the Japanese scale of up to 7.0. Police said there had been no immediate reports of any casualties or damage.
The earthquake caused buildings in Tokyo to sway and rattled houses in neighbouring Chiba Prefecture, where Narita airport, the main international airport serving Tokyo, is located.
"An earthquake of 4.5, measuring 2 on the Richter scale, struck at 10.04 this morning," the agency official said.
"Narita was among a number of major places in Chiba Prefecture which felt a strong tremor...The earthquake was strongest in the prefecture and its epicentre was 80 km (50 miles) deep," she said.
An earthquake of around four on the Japanese intensity scale is classed as a medium tremor strong enough to shake houses.
